newsitem.title: Italy: Italian shares close almost unchanged, below highs.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close almost unchanged, below highs.

text.p: 1545 GMT - Italian shares closed almost unchanged on Wednesday but well below the day's highs after a technical rebound which lifted values in the morning quickly ran out of steam and Wall Streat opened weaker.

* The all-share mibtel index closed 0.05 percent higher at 11,646 with the blue chip mib30 up 0.07 percent at 17,189. Volumes were thin but slightly higher than on Tuesday at 612 billion lire, up from 529 billion lire.
* Olivetti closed 2.28 percent higher at 609.1 lire, boosted by reports that France Telecom is close to agreeing to acquire a stake in the Italian company's Infostrada venture.
* ENI shares took a dive, closing 1.99 percent lower at 8,226 lire, on fears that the sale to the public of a third tranche of shares would drain liquidity out of the market.
* The Treasury said on Tuesday that it would sell a fresh bloc of ENI shares by the summer, lowering its stake in the company from 69 percent to as low as 51 percent.

* Snia also went into steep decline, closing 3.31 percent lower while Brembo stabilised after Tuesday's declines on disappointment with the company's worse-than-expected 1996 results. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
